description: In the comic version, gave Freyalise the idea to combine forces.

timeline.summary: Liana gives the Moxen to Kristina and Jared during her duel with Ravidel so he will not take them.

timeline.summary: Leshrac rings the Chime as Kristina yanks it away and Telemar goes up in a mushroom cloud.

timeline.summary: Kristina is revealed alive but burned and sparkless.
